name: Song of the Woodlands
body:
School: enchantment (charm, mind-affecting, sonic); Level: bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, druid 2, witch 2

CASTING

Components: V
Casting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: close (25-ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets: one or more creatures within a 30 ft.-radius emanation
Duration: 1 round/level
Saving Throw: Will disbelief (harmless); Spell Resistance: yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

This spell calls forth a hauntingly beautiful melody that inspires your allies. Allies (other than you) gain a +2 morale bonus on Will saves and weapon damage rolls. If you are an elf, fey, or halfling, you also gain these bonuses. Furthermore, allies other than you who are elves, fey, or halflings gain a +2 sacred bonus to AC.
